reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: I'm absolutely delighted with the work from Paul and David. The wallpapering (busy design) and bedroom painting have completely transformed the room. The finish is excellent; everything was done with great care and attention to detail, and the result looks fantastic…
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Paul, assisted by David, decorated three bedrooms for me. He was great from start to finish - giving advice on the best paints to use and colour matching perfectly. The work was finished to a very high standard and the house left clean and tidy at the end of every day…
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Paul was excellent, he did my whole house and the process was completely stress free, the result? Absolute perfection.
